description: You are a regulatory affairs manager at a medical device company preparing a regulatory dossier for an AI-powered diagnostic software product that qualifies as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Research the current regulatory landscape from multiple authoritative sources. You must: (1) Find and download at least one official FDA guidance document on Software as a Medical Device or AI/ML in medical devices from FDA.gov; (2) Search the Federal Register for at least one rule, proposed rule, or notice related to SaMD or AI in medical devices; (3) Find IMDRF (International Medical Device Regulators Forum) guidance on SaMD classification or clinical evaluation; (4) Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'FDA Regulatory Research' containing at least 6 bookmarks across these three sources (FDA, Federal Register, and IMDRF); (5) Write a regulatory requirements matrix to ~/Documents/samd_regulatory_matrix.txt that covers: FDA's pre-market requirements, IMDRF's SaMD classification framework, and any international harmonization notes.
